metadata.alt_text: Bar chart of mean score on each NASA TLX attribute for 7 pointing conditions in smartphone study. The y-axis indicates mean score and the x-axis indicates TLX attributes. For each attribute, each bar represents each pointing condition in the following sequence: VC, VBP2TR, VBP2TA, VBP1RR, WDP2TR, WDP2TA and WDP1RR. The error bar of each pointing conditions and the significant difference between each other are also visualised.
metadata.domain_context: From a paper published at CHI (2020). Figure caption: Figure 8. The mean responses for the attributes of NASA TLX questionnaire. The standard error bar is visualized. The statistical signiﬁcances evaluated by Wilcoxon rank sum test are marked with stars (∗∗ = p < 0.01 and ∗ = p < 0.05).
